I added a few computational API lemmas to set up a partial abstract boundary for Representation.ind, which leads to:
Large changes (2:check:)

  • :check: build/module/Mathlib.RepresentationTheory.FiniteIndex//instructions: -9.9G (-18.35%)
  • :check: build/module/Mathlib.RepresentationTheory.Induced//instructions: -13.6G (-20.75%)

The current IndV.mk is user unfriendly and causes performence issue in downstream application. This PR #41808 fixes the user interface and partially fixes the performence issue. I would appreciate it if anyone would like to have a look.

By the way, I expect thorought fix should also make IndV not talk to Coinvariants anymore (because the current Coinvariants also seems unsatisfactory), but there should be a seperate PR on it.
